snippet.title: Puzzling Places - Monthly Pack #10
snippet.description:
A brand new variety puzzle pack - the "Monthly Pack #10" is here! 

This pack covers an eclectic mix of structures from France, Turkey, Serbia, England, and USA.

Available today for $4.99.

For more detailed information about the puzzle pack, refer to the announcement post here: https://puzzlingplaces.ghost.io/m10
